Class ModelExperience

java.lang.Object
guiExperience.ModelExperience
public final class ModelExperience extends Object

Title: ModelExperience

Description: Binds experience operations to the signed-in account and selected lesson. These identities cannot be changed by editing form fields.

      public long add(String whatDone, String howDone, String elapsedMinutes, String memberEffort) throws SQLException
